Opening of the new reading room

The new reading room on the second floor opens next Monday. It offers forty quiet desks, daylight from three sides and a small collection of local history.

Visitors can reserve a desk online or at the front desk, for up to four hours a day, free of charge for all library card holders.

Please note that the lift to the second floor is closed for maintenance until the end of the month; staff will bring requested items downstairs.
